title: Israel Launches Attack in Gaza
summary: A local health official said at least 26 people had been killed in the attacks, which the Israeli military said had targeted Hamas commanders.

title: SpaceX Seeks FCC Nod to Build Data Center Constellation in Space
summary: SpaceX is requesting permission to launch as many as 1 million satellites into the Earth’s orbit in order to pull off Elon Musk’s latest grand vision of putting data centers in space to do complex computing for artificial intelligence.
